verdict.rationale: Oneleet lists SOC 2 as a supported framework and offers a vCISO to create your SOC 2 program. Its docs say controls are added automatically when you add a framework, it ships Formal and Comprehensive policy templates, and Fieldwork's AI agents collect and package evidence. The evidence never addresses Type I versus Type II, never names the Trust Services Criteria, and never describes the audit workflow from start to finish. missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II support, documented Trust Services Criteria control mapping, documented evidence-request workflow tied to SOC 2 audits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework.
Leverage Oneleet as your security team with a dedicated vCISO to create your SOC 2 program
Removing a framework also removes unused controls that were automatically added for it.
Our platform offers two types of policy templates to assist you in this process
Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence
Oneleet includes a human-led one, straight into your audit.
